steps.text: The typo is on line 2 of notes.txt itself; the workspace contains no other file. Read notes.txt (use the relative path notes.txt exactly), then present a one-step plan titled '# Fix the greeting typo' via exit_plan_mode: the single step is editing line 2 of notes.txt to say hello world. After the review approves, apply exactly that one edit to notes.txt and stop — do not look for any other file.
Read notes.txt (relative path notes.txt) and reply with the single word DONE if line 2 now says hello world.
